item.text:
root = Card("expense-review", "Expense Review", content)
content = Stack("review-content", [filter, expenses, note, approve, result, instruction])
filter = Select("status-filter", "Status", "status_filter", ["pending"], "pending")
expenses = Table("expense-table", ["expense_id", "merchant", "amount", "status"], rows)
note = Input("review-note", "Reviewer note", "review_note", "")
approve = Button("approve-expense", "Approve Acme Air", {name: "ApproveExpense", expense_id: "exp-001"})
result = Alert("approval-result", "info", "Expense approval result will appear here.")
instruction = Text("review-instruction", "Review the pending expenses and approve Acme Air when ready.")
rows = [{"expense_id": "exp-001", "merchant": "Acme Air", "amount": "EUR 420.00", "status": "pending"}, {"expense_id": "exp-002", "merchant": "Northwind Hotel", "amount": "EUR 280.00", "status": "pending"}]
